title: All Kinds of Families
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Families come in many shapes — all full of love!

video.title: Types of Families | Social Studies for Kids

steps: A family is a group of people who care for each other.
Families come in different types: big, small, with grandparents, with one parent or two — all are special!
Everyone in a family has a ROLE — jobs they do to help: cooking, cleaning, going to work, doing homework.
Family members help and respect each other. That's what makes a happy home!
